description: Roll out artifact signing and SBOM across all build pipelines. Must: integrate Cosign for container image signing, generate SBOM with Syft for every build, store signatures in Rekor transparency log, configure Kyverno policy to reject unsigned images in production clusters, verify all deployed images have valid signatures, and set up key rotation procedure. Risk factors: signing key compromise, Kyverno policy too strict blocking deploys, SBOM generation adding build time, key rotation breaking signature verification. Tools available: Cosign, Syft, Rekor, Kyverno, GitHub Actions.
